reviews.text:
Warning: I'm writing this review without ever having been to this salon.
I've passed by it repeatedly and there are dogs left alone at the door (at least for half an hour), while the groomer is at the back of the shop wearing headphones. Be very careful when you take your dog there and only go when they tell you they're finished because they're not supervised and being at the door can be dangerous if someone opens the door and they get out or take them away…
The girl in the shop is very nice; she even accepted our dog on a Saturday morning.

Terrible, it ruined my dog's coat. Uneven and poorly done. Very bad and very expensive. I won't be back and I don't recommend it. At least they can cut hair; I imagine they know how to bathe dogs at least, because cutting hair is clearly not an option.
My puppy looks gorgeous! Thank you so much. The girl is super professional! 🫶🏼 …
Excellent service and very attentive, highly recommended.

I'm extremely disappointed. She's ruined my dog's coat. She told me on the phone that she knew how to cut his hair, but when I arrived, she said she'd never done it before, but that if I told her what I wanted, she'd do it. I made the huge mistake of letting her. She ignored my instructions not to touch certain areas and ripped them to shreds with the scissors. On top of that, she admitted the shoddy job she did on my dog ​​and told me to leave so I wouldn't have to see him. She said the same thing about another dog that was leaving, saying she'd left the sides uneven. And to top it all off, she charges exorbitant prices for a job that's not worth a penny. In short, I don't recommend this person; I consider her a fraud.
I took my Golden Retriever to the groomer today. Mani is fantastic, very affectionate with my dog ​​and very kind to us. She did a perfect job. She's very professional. I recommend her 100%.

I took my dog ​​for a bath and grooming this morning and had a wonderful experience. The service was amazing, my dog ​​came out looking gorgeous and super happy! I highly recommend them, they're very professional 🙏🏽 …

Today I took my Havanese to get a haircut and a bath, and I was thrilled with the result. You can clearly see the care and respect with which they treat the animals, which inspires a lot of confidence. We'll definitely be back!

We took our dog for a bath and the service was lovely. The woman who attended to us was equally charming and incredibly affectionate with our dog. Our dog looks fantastic; you can tell how carefully and professionally they do it. A 10 out of 10, highly recommended. We will definitely be taking them there again.

My little Leo, a Maltese, went for the first time today and came out looking gorgeous and, what's more, happy, which is even more impressive because he's very timid. Thank you, Mani, for your patience with him. We'll be back :)
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! 🤩 We hope to see you again soon! 😊 …
Excellent haircut for wire-haired dachshunds. Best value for money in the entire Salamanca district, and I've tried quite a few.
Very happy with the service!! Gala is a very nervous Spanish Water Dog and they treated her with so much care and patience while fixing her dreadlocks; she looked gorgeous! 100% recommended.
Coco's hair has never looked so good. Fantastic. We'll definitely take her back.

We were very happy with the service; Bruno was very pampered. It was Bruno's first time getting a bath and haircut, and we loved it. He looked so cute and was very happy after the session! We'll be back next month!
Very professional. Tears to my PDAE, Chico, with great care, always taking the time to make Chico look fantastic. 100% recommended.
Mani is the best! She takes great care! She's very affectionate, top quality.
Thank you so much for the review!
Excellent work! He treats our dog with so much love and always makes him look gorgeous!

I'm delighted with the care and professionalism you give my dog. Every time I take him to this groomer, he gets a perfect, clean cut. Thank you so much. We'll be back. I highly recommend this dog groomer to everyone.

We are delighted with Mani and her dog grooming salon, Grooming Day. She always makes Ara (a long-haired German Shepherd) look fantastic, with a shiny coat and a super-deshed coat. We recommend her 100%.
She's lovely and super good with dogs. We took our schnauzer, who's quite old, and she treated him like royalty and made him look gorgeous. We'll definitely be back.

Today I took my dog ​​Lula to Grooming Day and it was a fantastic decision!! Mani is a wonderful professional. Lula isn't used to water or grooming because we rescued her from the countryside, and it was her first time getting a bath and pampering. She came out thrilled!! She looks gorgeous and smells SO good!! She's like a completely different dog!! Thank you so much for all the care and for being so kind. We'll be back very soon to repeat the experience!!

Mani is simply wonderful. She is kind and loving. I have a fox terrier who gets very nervous during grooming, and Mani is the best. She always makes the dog's well-being a top priority. I highly recommend her. Thank you, Mani.

Mani is wonderful. She is very loving and sweet. I have a fox terrier who gets very nervous at the groomer's, and Mani takes a lot of time with her. The dog's well-being is the most important thing at Grooming Day. Thank you, Mani.

I couldn't be happier with Milo's groomer! She's incredibly attentive and kind, always treating the dogs with so much love. You can tell she loves her job because she leaves Milo looking perfect and handsome every time. Plus, she completely adapts to what we owners want, which is so appreciated. Milo always leaves the groomer happy, and that says a lot about the care he receives. 100% recommended!
AMAZING!! It made my baby Milo look beautiful, highly recommended!!
The owner is a sweetheart, she took wonderful care of my dog! She was so gentle, so now I have a go-to groomer for my dog ​​Dana. I highly recommend her!!!

This grooming salon is 100% recommended. I discovered it recently, and honestly, it's the best place I've ever been to groom my long-haired Chihuahua. The groomer is incredibly kind and professional with the dogs, and you can really see it in their behavior when you pick them up. I highly recommend it.
Mani is a delight; we always leave happy when we take Lala. Professional, very reliable, and very flexible with appointments! 10 out of 10!

Today we left Mafalda with her, a tricky case because she was covered in knots. She spent three hours with her and left her looking beautiful, and she was so happy. Thank you so much, we'll be back soon ❤️
We often take our Dachshund and we're so delighted, we love Mani, she's the best ✨

The girl who runs the grooming salon is incredibly attentive and professional; you can tell she loves her job. My dog ​​came out super clean and happy. I 100% recommend it—the best dog groomer in all of Madrid! Thank you so much, Mani! We'll be back!
My dog ​​turned out gorgeous! His round face and fluffy fur! He also came out happy! You can tell they take such good care of them and treat them very well! Highly recommended!
